Hi Jennifer — thanks for the clear list. High-level answers below and I've attached the attestation and our most recent scan summary. Marcus/Laura I've cc'd for the historical exports.

Quick summary (operational):
- Internal authenticated scanning: weekly (Nessus, credentialed). Owner: SecOps (Marcus Lin).
- External perimeter scanning: monthly (Qualys), with an additional external sweep prior to major public releases or infra changes.
- Container image scanning: on-image-build (Trivy) + weekly cluster scans.
- On-demand scans: triggered after high-impact deploys or when a new CVE affects our stack.

CVE remediation SLA (standard policy):
- Critical (RCE/active exploit): 7 calendar days (mitigate/patch or apply approved compensating control + documented exception).
- High (privilege escalation/important data exposure): 30 calendar days.
- Medium: 90 calendar days.
- Low: next quarterly cycle (documented).

Exceptions: Any SLA exception requires documented approval from Security (SecOps) + Engineering manager and must create a Jira ticket tagged SUP-3421.

Evidence provided: attached:
- 2026-04-30-weekly-scan-summary.pdf (internal Nessus summary)
- vm-remediation-sla-attestation.docx (signed attestation PDF/DOCX)
